summary: This directory centralizes data encoding and decoding utilities, providing consistent logic for transforming data formats such as Base64 and character sets like Shift-JIS across the application.
responsibilities: Transform data between different encoding formats
Decode encoded string or binary data
relationships: The encoding utilities provide the necessary logic to interpret raw data as specific character formats like Shift-JIS.
The decoding logic standardizes the conversion of varied input formats into a consistent internal data representation.
designDecisions: Co-location of transformation logic for modular accessibility
Standardized interface for diverse encoding algorithms
